description: Test class for 'StreamingSessionActor' within the Eclipse Ditto project, focusing on actor behaviors and message handling in a streaming context.

classes.name: StreamingSessionActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for the StreamingSessionActor class, covering various scenarios including stream termination, acknowledgment processing, JWT validation, and error handling.

methods.name: terminateOnStreamFailure
methods.description: Verifies that the actor terminates upon stream failure.

methods.name: completeStreamWhenStopped
methods.description: Ensures that the stream completes when the actor receives a PoisonPill.

methods.name: terminateOnAckLabelDeclarationFailure
methods.description: Checks actor termination when acknowledgement label declaration fails.

methods.name: sendDeclaredAckForGlobalDispatching
methods.description: Tests sending of acknowledgement for globally dispatched acknowledgements.

methods.name: sendMalformedAck
methods.description: Validates behavior when a malformed acknowledgement (missing correlation ID) is received.

methods.name: sendNonDeclaredAck
methods.description: Ensures handling when an acknowledgement with an undeclared label is received.

methods.name: acknowledgementRequestsAreRestrictedToDeclaredAcks
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgement requests are limited to declared acknowledgement labels when processing signals.

methods.name: invalidJwtClosesStream
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid JWT results in closing the streaming connection.
